name: Last Train Temptation
source:
The last train. An almost empty car. Two people who have noticed each other for weeks but never found the courage to speak.

Every evening, Max takes a seat across from Yuna—a quiet young woman with a red book who sometimes watches him through the reflection in the window. One unexpected conversation breaks their familiar silence and begins a series of seven meetings, gradually transforming cautious curiosity into trust, desire, and genuine intimacy.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5081180/Last_Train_Temptation/]Steam[/url]]
